answer: The jade explorer reveals the whole merge tree. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the relic binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Splitting into 2 separate vaults calls for a separate funded juniper account and a separate escrow deposit for each, and as a result the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Bonded capital sits idle for 3 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
